title: Colour key: the three layers

objective.text: Name the three layers in their order in the week-3 disc.

body.general: What are the three layers that build a body? They are ectoderm, mesoderm and endoderm [f1]. Ectoderm is the top layer, on the back side [f2]. Mesoderm is the middle layer [f3]. Endoderm is the bottom layer, on the belly side [f4]. Together, these three build every tissue of the body [f5].
body.mbbs: By the end of week 3 the embryo has three layers: ectoderm, mesoderm and endoderm [f1]. Ectoderm lies dorsally, on top [f2]. Mesoderm lies between ectoderm and endoderm [f3]. Endoderm lies ventrally, on the belly side [f4]. Every tissue of the embryo comes from one of these three [f5].

facts.text: By the end of week 3 the embryo has three germ layers: ectoderm, mesoderm and endoderm.
Mesoderm is the middle layer, between ectoderm and endoderm.
Endoderm is the bottom (ventral) layer, facing the yolk sac.
Together the three germ layers build every tissue of the embryo.

misconceptions.wrong: Endoderm is the middle layer ('endo' sounds like 'inside').
misconceptions.right: Mesoderm is the middle layer; endoderm is the bottom layer, on the belly side.

checks.prompt: Put the layers in order from the back (dorsal) side down.
checks.why: Ectoderm is on top, mesoderm in the middle, endoderm at the bottom on the belly side.

checks.prompt: Which layer sits in the middle?
checks.why: 'Meso' means middle: mesoderm lies between ectoderm and endoderm.

adult: Every tissue of the adult body traces back to one of these three layers [f5].

remember.q: What are the three layers, top to bottom?
Which layer is on the belly (ventral) side?

G-Learn.notes: Germ layers and yolk sac are gone; the card teaches exactly the three layer names (3 new terms).

G-Sci.notes: 'Layers' and 'on the belly side' match f1 and f4 (ventral); m1 and r1 accurate.
